smallVisibleCandidate.sharedContract: Use existing StarfallTheme and SkyMenuSurface/Section first. Register a narrow shared summary role only if native comparison demonstrates a distinct reusable need. No screen-local substitute or general reader framework.
smallVisibleCandidate.decisionBoundary: This is a source-observed emphasis inconsistency, not a proved visual failure. Reproduce on then-current native captures before implementation. Reject extra fixed header/footer height, hidden early content, shrunk captions or diagram decoration. Do not enlarge every already semibold shower step to imitate Help.

observableAcceptance: Whole phone/relevant tablet default and AX5 screens distinguish context, phases and total; all facts remain native and complete. Return/Back stays reachable with existing48pt targets and fixed-footer ownership.

Shower reading preserves running deadline/save/world; actual growth/landing/block matches evaluation. Source change/background/replacement withdraws stale reading without pausing/holding. Full Board/Arriving retain absence.

Last clear/accounting retain phases, overlaps/manual paths, zero-light history, survivors/refills/totals. Reading cannot replay/award. Result decisions precede detail; replacement/cold restore retain existing boundaries.

Help preserves current/retained rules, canonical detail, warning priority and revision withdrawal. Reading/Close/reopen/pans cannot exchange a star, create a round, grant progression or alter showers. Keep scripts distinct from generated feedback.

Inspect normal motion and legitimate quiet paths separately; pan over passive diagrams and read the complete final line. Preserve Sunny hit/extent/pan checks: earlier intermittent stalls have no proved product cause. No weakened assertions/retries. Actual VoiceOver, physical comfort/contrast and recognition remain separate.
